nodes.label: 8-Phase Debugging and Testing Protocol
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive debugging protocol for Backend (Python/pytest) and Frontend (Next.js/Vitest/Playwright). Covers 8 phases: Input Validation, System Mapping, Hypothesis Generation, Test Design, Elimination, Fix Design, Self-Review, Regression Test, Verdict. Includes epistemic rules (VERIFIED/HYPOTHESIS/UNKNOWN/FALSE) and fix budget constraints (<=15 lines, <=1 function).
